title: ZotFlag
text:
ZotFlag infographic


It is a Zotero extension (for Zotero 7 to 10) that automatically adds tags to selected references when their metadata matches lists kept in CSV files.

GitHub Repository
Discussion, application and empirical analysis (in French).

GPL-3.0-or-later. Author: Pascal Martinolli (specifications); code generated with Claude.

« Make it so. » was a catchphrase written by Gene Roddenberry, inspired by the British naval officers of the XIXe century. It was first used in “Encounter At Farpoint” (28 September 1987) and then reused with much delight by Captain Jean-Luc Picard (In memoriam) during the run of ST:TNG 1987-1994.
